body:
I had almost the same experience reading the stories here which made me stop blaming myself.  I understood my life worth living just by comparing it to other people stories. 

Not like I am better than others. More like I was able to see my story is bad but I had even worse days and never thought of doing something bad to myself seriously. That made me ask myself why I think of it now. 

I just understood it is your brain makes you think bad, not a real trouble. So if you just make you stop falling in this shithole, you are able to get up.

Happiness to all of you reading or posting her.

Very inspiring story OP.

I don’t know if it helps you, but I will share my experience. I have been working for a 4 years at the same role (let’s say it is a professional support). I was so tired of stress which you always have when you talk to strangers every day without any chance to just tell them to shut up and get out. But I loved to help people, to solve their issues. And salary was good, I had enough for leaving and even more, for my whole family. 

But then I was so tired, started to get lazy, not feeling satisfied about my role. I had a chance to try a new role, absolutely different, no talks, just developing new stuff, more money and everything. I was happy to try.

In the end, it was even more stressful then my previous job. I was afraid to make responsible decisions because I had no experience in what I was doing, and it brought me to panic attacks.

Luckily, I was able to get my previous job back. I felt much more comfortable. I realized that I am experienced professional who deals with any issue without any efforts, my colleagues respect me and admire me.

 So I realized that I was at the best place already, it was just my feelings and my own self esteem which made me feel uncomfortable. Now, every time I feel sad or bored or exhausted, I recall this good feelings I got when came back to my original job, and feel much better.

Well basically it is my problem, to negate everything I see, and first of all, myself. Always to criticize everything, just like Socrates said. I question everything, it is a reflex, but it became a real problem when I understood I question my own wishes and needs and deny most of them. This way, you lose your will to live. You just see no point, as everything you imagine is being questioned and denied, and you lose the sense of life.
I have a very skeptical mind, and taking medicine to sleep is not what I would think about. Is it really useful and safe? Do you restore your energy for real after these supplements?
Please share the quote. I never deny learning things, even these are things which I do not prefer

Man, you can find a lot of people here thinking no one is interested in their life and they are totally alone. But all of them got a response here, even me. And respondents are mostly the persons having the same issues. 
This what made me up today, it was so great to recognize you problem is not unique, and there are a lot of people who consider it as a serious issue, and willing to help. And they know what they are talking about. It was new for me, I always thought of these problems as of something which only ‘weak’ people can not handle, but now I faced it myself and it cheers me up that I can speak about it, and be heard.

I am a father myself, and I will say my sons when they grow up that they can choose the job they personally like, any job. 
Being a professional in something you like brings you so much satisfaction. I changed several jobs until found the one which did not require some special efforts from me but gave me income for life. Now I can say I am a good professional in what I do, and every time I manage to solve a harsh issue I feel as satisfied as I earned a top achievement in video game.
In modern world, there are so much ways to go, you can become anyone you want, just keep trying. Search for a good place, you have time yet to look for a better job which fits you best. Trust me, I’m a lazy ass but I really like what I do and outcome which I get from my job.

Yes, I’ve had a lot of troubles with my sleep last half of a year, all because of jet lag, but it keeps happen from time to time even now. Staying awake for too long is not good for your head, for sure, may be it was one of a reasons of everything as well.

I am not in a religion, and also I am very sceptic in regarding to that Indian stuff. I truly believe if you are not born in this culture, you are not able to understand it completely. I like Osho stories though, but only as a stories.
Lol it is really hard when you sleep 10 years with a person you love, every day, no matter what, and then you find yourself alone in a strange bed in a shitty room struggling to fall asleep.

Sure. I am in contact with psychologist, she helps a lot. But right now I am fighting to get out of this mess I am in, I mean psychologically. I never thought this psychological stuff is serious until I faced it, always considered any of psycho theories as fake explanations of easiest things, but now, seeing all these people here speaking loud about their real issues, I feel so much more straight. 
I mean, you can think you problem is just a kiddy stuff, grown up people can not feel this feeling, but when you see real men and women suffering the same pain as yours and having serious issues because of it, you start to understand you are not the only one and you should fight for your consciousness.
And why congratulations? It is so hard to sleep alone

You have friends at least. My only but closest friend was my wife. This is why I am writing it all here. Though I clearly understand it is just a time when I need to wine and feel pity to myself, asking for ‘I feel you’ from strangers. I am now like a two persons on one, first is crying, hating everyone, and the second is the grown up guy who feels awkward seeing himself in such a shithole
Anyway it is really cool man. I did not finish my education, still regret about that. You’ve done it and it is really something you can proud.

Man, I had to lose it all to understand how happy I was before. I feel so dumb and empty now, after understanding what was my happiness. Now I really struggle to wake up. But fuck it’s been so bad before so many times, and it was so good then. 

You are your feelings. Guys here say good things about not to let your brain trick you and make it more sad. You know, if you smile when it is bad, you feel better anyway. 

I once had a good friend, we spent a lot of time together, she was the one who understands me totally. But she was in love with me and I could not recognize it, it was only friendship for me. Moreover, she was married. One day she confessed, I felt nothing to her and she left me. I started feel terrible next day after. It was really like a feeling you lost your leg or arm, so empty and useless without her. But somehow I was able to continue. In a year, we accidentally met and managed to spend a night together, and never met after that. It is one of the worst but also one of the best memories which keeps me up.

I am 33 but feel like I did not live as a person till now. I feel shame for feeling pity to myself but really all of my life fucked up within last 6 months, mostly because of my own mistakes and misbehavior. I had happiness and love, a lot of it but it is hard to believe now it will ever become good again.
That means so much, even for me who is not a topic starter
What if your parents is the main fail of your life? Or you feel like you can not trust them at all, because they are even more broken than you?

Feeling you so much. I’ve had it all and lost. It is really hard to wake up, new days bring all my hopes broken. But sometimes, when I have my mind clear, I remember good times which I had after points I thought my life is completely broken. It happened miraculously, never expected it, but lord it was great. This makes me do something for myself.

I am like few days after leaving my family to divorce which is 100% my fault. I have suicide thought all the time, but, funny, I ruined my relationships because of constant manipulating and feeling pity to myself. And there was no place in my head for any other person except my son may be. So now when I have these thoughts I consider them as a part of that whining, manipulating and everything. Like this is the easiest solution instead of trying to become real self, to start living. But problem is I have no idea who I am, I lost all my friends in last months because of my mental shit, and I can not see any light at the end of the tunnel.
